title: Reinforcement learning for hardware acceleration and system-level optimization on FPGA and integrated-circuit platforms: A survey
abstract: arXiv:2610.28699v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables adaptive and autonomous decision-making in embedded, edge, and heterogeneous computing systems. Field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) and integrated circuits (ICs) offer low latency, energy efficiency, and architectural flexibility for RL deployment, while introducing challenges in resource constraints, implementation complexity, and hardware-algorithm co-design. This review surveys more than 100 studies on RL implementations across FPGA and IC platforms, emphasizing architectures, implementation strategies, performance evaluation, and applications. The literature is organized by RL family, including model-based Markov decision processes, classical value-based methods, deep RL, actor-critic, policy-gradient, and multi-agent approaches. translated_title: 面向FPGA与集成电路平台的强化学习硬件加速与系统级优化：综述
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）能够在嵌入式、边缘和异构计算系统中实现自适应与自主决策。现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）和集成电路（IC）为强化学习部署提供了低延迟、高能效和架构灵活性，但同时也带来了资源受限、实现复杂度以及硬件-算法协同设计方面的挑战。本综述调研了100多项关于FPGA与IC平台上强化学习实现的研究，重点关注架构、实现策略、性能评估和应用。相关文献按强化学习类别进行组织，包括基于模型的马尔可夫决策过程、经典的基于值的方法、深度强化学习、actor-critic、策略梯度以及多智能体方法。我们进一步按抽象层次、硬件实现策略和应用领域对研究进行分类，考察强化学习算法如何映射到可重构与固定硬件之上。
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了100余项在FPGA和集成电路平台上实现强化学习的研究，按算法类别、抽象层次、硬件实现策略和应用领域进行分类，总结了强化学习硬件加速与系统级优化的架构与实现方法。
en_tdlr: This survey reviews over 100 studies on reinforcement learning implementations across FPGA and integrated-circuit platforms, organizing them by RL family, abstraction level, hardware realization strategy, and application domain to summarize architectures and methods for hardware acceleration and system-level optimization.
